description: This file contains the implementation of item variant management functions for an ERP system, including creation, validation, attribute handling, and variant generation.

classes.name: ItemVariantExistsError
classes.description: Custom validation error for existing item variants.

classes.name: InvalidItemAttributeValueError
classes.description: Custom validation error for invalid attribute values.

classes.name: ItemTemplateCannotHaveStock
classes.description: Custom validation error for stock restrictions on item templates.

methods.name: get_variant
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an item variant based on provided attributes, template, manufacturer, or existing variants.

methods.name: make_variant_based_on_manufacturer
methods.description: Creates a new item variant based on manufacturer and manufacturer part number.

methods.name: validate_item_variant_attributes
methods.description: Validates attributes of an item or variant, including range and value checks.

methods.name: validate_is_incremental
methods.description: Checks if a numeric attribute value is within range and in correct increments.

methods.name: validate_item_attribute_value
methods.description: Validates if an attribute value is valid for a given attribute and item.

methods.name: get_attribute_values
methods.description: Fetches attribute values and numeric attribute ranges for an item.

methods.name: find_variant
methods.description: Finds an existing variant matching specified attributes.

methods.name: create_variant
methods.description: Creates a new item variant with specified attribute values.

methods.name: enqueue_multiple_variant_creation
methods.description: Enqueues creation of multiple variants based on attribute combinations, with limit checks.

methods.name: create_multiple_variants
methods.description: Generates and creates multiple variants from attribute combinations.

methods.name: generate_keyed_value_combinations
methods.description: Generates all combinations of attribute values for variant creation.

methods.name: copy_attributes_to_variant
methods.description: Copies relevant attributes from a template item to a variant.

methods.name: make_variant_item_code
methods.description: Constructs item code and name for a variant based on attribute abbreviations.

methods.name: create_variant_doc_for_quick_entry
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a variant document for quick entry, based on template and attributes.
